name: Thick-Cut Duelist's Burger
desc: A burger with a thick-cut steak as its main ingredient. The sumptuous bread gives off a pleasantly toasty aroma, which complements the rich sauce lavished on the thick steak. A variety of garnishes serve to enrich the mouthfeel and provide added nutritional value.

value.text: Increases all party members' ATK by 272 and CRIT Rate by 8% for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).
